I went into 6 yrs of suicidal depression and tried everything there was to try to get better. Nothing worked. I was never someone who believed in the supernatural or spiritual. Then one day I tried Jesus in my room. I just started talking to Him and gave Him all my brokenness and suffering. I started to repent all of my poor decisions I had made throughout my life and in that moment of pouring my heart out repenting I had a supernatural encounter that completely dissolved all my addictions and depressions. My life transformed miraculously. Jesus is the way the truth and the life.
